# Objective

Illustrate differences in Bd prevalence and load across Panamanian species.

## Setup

```{r}
#| eval: true
#| output: false
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "Show setup code"

# setup
librarian::shelf(tidyverse, dbplyr, here, janitor, RPostgres, DBI, RIBBiTR-BII/ribbitrrr, brms, tidybayes, ggplot2, emmeans, ggrepel, stan-dev/cmdstanr)

## Connect to DB
dbcon = hopToDB("ribbitr", hopReg = FALSE)

# table pointers
db_bd = tbl(dbcon, Id("survey_data", "bd_qpcr_results"))
db_sample = tbl(dbcon, Id("survey_data", "sample"))
db_capture = tbl(dbcon, Id("survey_data", "capture"))
db_survey = tbl(dbcon, Id("survey_data", "survey"))
db_visit = tbl(dbcon, Id("survey_data", "visit"))
db_site = tbl(dbcon, Id("survey_data", "site"))
db_region = tbl(dbcon, Id("survey_data", "region"))
db_country = tbl(dbcon, Id("survey_data", "country"))

bd_sample = db_sample %>%
  right_join(db_capture, by = "capture_id") %>%
  left_join(db_survey, by = "survey_id") %>%
  left_join(db_visit, by = "visit_id") %>%
  left_join(db_site, by = "site_id") %>%
  left_join(db_region, by = "region_id") %>%
  left_join(db_country, by = "country_id") %>%
  filter(sample_type == "bd")
```
## Data selection

```{r}
#| eval: true
#| warning: false
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "Show data collection code"

# define life_stage_simple by SVL
bd_population = bd_sample %>%
  filter(region == "pennsylvania",
         # life_stage %in% c("adult"),
         !is.na(svl_mm)) %>%
  mutate(life_stage_simple = case_when(
    # us
    # https://animaldiversity.org/accounts/Acris_blanchardi/
    ((taxon_capture == "acris_blanchardi") & (svl_mm >= 16)) ~ "adult",
    ((taxon_capture == "acris_blanchardi") & (svl_mm < 16)) ~ "subadult",
    # Wright and Wright 1949
    ((taxon_capture == "anaxyrus_americanus") & (svl_mm >= 54)) ~ "adult",
    ((taxon_capture == "anaxyrus_americanus") & (svl_mm < 54)) ~ "subadult",
    # Lannoo 2005 (Amphibian Declines: The Conservation Status of United States Species)
    ((taxon_capture == "anaxyrus_canorus") & (svl_mm >= 48)) ~ "adult",
    ((taxon_capture == "anaxyrus_canorus") & (svl_mm < 48)) ~ "subadult",
    # Lannoo 2005
    ((taxon_capture == "anaxyrus_debilis") & (svl_mm >= 37)) ~ "adult",
    ((taxon_capture == "anaxyrus_debilis") & (svl_mm < 37)) ~ "subadult",
    # Conant and Collins 1991
    ((taxon_capture == "anaxyrus_fowleri") & (svl_mm >= 51)) ~ "adult",
    ((taxon_capture == "anaxyrus_fowleri") & (svl_mm < 51)) ~ "subadult",
    # Lannoo 2005
    ((taxon_capture == "hyla_chrysoscelis") & (svl_mm >= 32)) ~ "adult",
    ((taxon_capture == "hyla_chrysoscelis") & (svl_mm < 32)) ~ "subadult",
    # Conant & Collins 1998
    ((taxon_capture == "hyla_cinerea") & (svl_mm >= 32)) ~ "adult",
    ((taxon_capture == "hyla_cinerea") & (svl_mm < 32)) ~ "subadult",
    # Johnson 1987
    ((taxon_capture == "hyla_versicolor") & (svl_mm >= 32)) ~ "adult",
    ((taxon_capture == "hyla_versicolor") & (svl_mm < 32)) ~ "subadult",
    # Minton, 2001 / Lanoo 2005
    ((taxon_capture == "lithobates_blairi") & (svl_mm >= 51)) ~ "adult",
    ((taxon_capture == "lithobates_blairi") & (svl_mm < 51)) ~ "subadult",
    # Platz and Mecham 1963
    ((taxon_capture == "lithobates_chiricahuensis") & (svl_mm >= 57)) ~ "adult",
    ((taxon_capture == "lithobates_chiricahuensis") & (svl_mm < 57)) ~ "subadult",
    # Minton 2001
    ((taxon_capture == "lithobates_palustris") & (svl_mm >= 43)) ~ "adult",
    ((taxon_capture == "lithobates_palustris") & (svl_mm < 43)) ~ "subadult",
    # Conant and Collins, 1991
    ((taxon_capture == "lithobates_sphenocephalus") & (svl_mm >= 51)) ~ "adult",
    ((taxon_capture == "lithobates_sphenocephalus") & (svl_mm < 51)) ~ "subadult",
    # Lannoo 2005
    ((taxon_capture == "pseudacris_crucifer") & (svl_mm >= 20)) ~ "adult",
    ((taxon_capture == "pseudacris_crucifer") & (svl_mm < 20)) ~ "subadult",
    # Hulse, C. and McCoy C. J. and Ellen Censky ,1998.
    ((taxon_capture == "pseudacris_feriarum") & (svl_mm >= 19)) ~ "adult",
    ((taxon_capture == "pseudacris_feriarum") & (svl_mm < 19)) ~ "subadult",
    # Lannoo 2005
    ((taxon_capture == "pseudacris_regilla") & (svl_mm >= 25)) ~ "adult",
    ((taxon_capture == "pseudacris_regilla") & (svl_mm < 25)) ~ "subadult",
    # Howard 1981
    ((taxon_capture == "rana_catesbeiana") & (svl_mm >= 95)) ~ "adult",
    ((taxon_capture == "rana_catesbeiana") & (svl_mm < 95)) ~ "subadult",
    # Lannoo 2005
    ((taxon_capture == "rana_clamitans") & (svl_mm >= 60)) ~ "adult",
    ((taxon_capture == "rana_clamitans") & (svl_mm < 60)) ~ "subadult",
    # https://www.nrc.gov/docs/ML1428/ML14282A848.pdf
    ((taxon_capture == "rana_pipiens") & (svl_mm >= 51)) ~ "adult",
    ((taxon_capture == "rana_pipiens") & (svl_mm < 51)) ~ "subadult",
    # Knapp
    ((taxon_capture == "rana_sierrae") & is.na(svl_mm)) ~ life_stage,
    ((taxon_capture == "rana_sierrae") & (svl_mm >= 40)) ~ "adult",
    ((taxon_capture == "rana_sierrae") & (svl_mm < 40)) ~ "subadult",
    # Martof 1963
    ((taxon_capture == "rana_sylvatica") & (svl_mm >= 37)) ~ "adult",
    ((taxon_capture == "rana_sylvatica") & (svl_mm < 37)) ~ "subadult",
    # Conant and Collins, 1991
    ((taxon_capture == "scaphiopus_holbrookii") & (svl_mm >= 44)) ~ "adult",
    ((taxon_capture == "scaphiopus_holbrookii") & (svl_mm < 44)) ~ "subadult",
    # Stebbins, 1985
    ((taxon_capture == "spea_multiplicata") & (svl_mm >= 37)) ~ "adult",
    ((taxon_capture == "spea_multiplicata") & (svl_mm < 37)) ~ "subadult",
    .default = life_stage)) %>%
  filter(life_stage_simple %in% "adult")

# identify valid species & seasons
bd_species_valid = bd_population %>%
  filter(!is.na(taxon_capture)) %>%
  group_by(taxon_capture) %>%
  summarise(count = n(),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(count >= 30) %>%
  arrange(desc(count)) %>%
  collect()



# identify valid samples
bd_sample_valid = bd_population %>%
  mutate(year = year(date),
         month = month(date),
         season = case_match(month,
                             c(12, 1, 2) ~ "winter",
                             c(3, 4, 5) ~ "spring",
                             c(6, 7, 8) ~ "summer",
                             c(9, 10, 11) ~ "fall",
                             .default = NA_character_),
         population = site) %>%
  filter(taxon_capture %in% bd_species_valid$taxon_capture) %>%
  filter(!is.na(life_stage_simple),
         life_stage_simple == "adult") %>%
  inner_join(db_bd %>%
              filter(!is.na(bd_detected)) %>%
              group_by(sample_id) %>%
              slice_sample(n = 1) %>%
              ungroup() %>%
              select(sample_id,
                     bd_detected,
                     bd_its1_copies_per_swab),
            by = "sample_id") %>%
  select(sample_id,
         bd_detected,
         bd_its1_copies_per_swab,
         sample_name,
         capture_id,
         taxon_capture,
         life_stage,
         life_stage_simple,
         svl_mm,
         body_mass_g,
         sex,
         observers_survey,
         photo,
         photo_id,
         survey_id,
         start_timestamp_utc,
         date,
         season,
         transect,
         site,
         site_id,
         geographic_area,
         population,
         region,
         country) %>%
  collect()

# final data selection and cleaning for model
bd_model = bd_sample_valid %>%
  filter(!is.na(bd_its1_copies_per_swab),
         !is.na(svl_mm)) %>%
  rename(bd_load = bd_its1_copies_per_swab) %>%
  mutate(log_bd_load = log(bd_load),
         bd_positive_load = if_else(bd_load > 0, bd_load, NA),
         log_bd_positive_load = log(bd_positive_load)) %>%
  select(bd_load,
         log_bd_load,
         bd_positive_load,
         log_bd_positive_load,
         bd_detected,
         svl_mm,
         transect,
         observers_survey,
         photo,
         photo_id,
         site,
         population,
         taxon_capture,
         life_stage,
         life_stage_simple,
         date,
         season,
         population,
         region,
         country)

head(bd_model)
```

# Observations
## Process observations
```{r}
get_species_name = function(taxon) {
  species_name = str_to_sentence(gsub("_", " ", taxon))
}

wilson_ci = function(p_hat, n, conf.level = 0.95) {
  z <- qnorm(1 - (1 - conf.level) / 2)
  
  denominator <- 1 + (z^2 / n)
  centre_adjusted_probability <- p_hat + (z^2 / (2 * n))
  adjusted_standard_deviation <- sqrt((p_hat * (1 - p_hat) / n) + (z^2 / (4 * n^2)))
  
  lower_bound <- (centre_adjusted_probability - z * adjusted_standard_deviation) / denominator
  upper_bound <- (centre_adjusted_probability + z * adjusted_standard_deviation) / denominator
  
  return(c(lower_bound = lower_bound, upper_bound = upper_bound))
}

wilson_ci_lower = function(p_hat, n, conf.level = 0.95) {
  ws = wilson_ci(p_hat, n, conf.level)
  return(ws[1])
}

wilson_ci_upper = function(p_hat, n, conf.level = 0.95) {
  ws = wilson_ci(p_hat, n, conf.level)
  return(ws[2])
}

sample_stats = function(obs) {
  obs %>%
    group_by(taxon_capture) %>%
    summarise(n = n(),
              n_pos = sum(bd_load > 0),
              bd_prevalence = sum(bd_load > 0) / n(),
              bd_prevalence_ci_lower = wilson_ci_lower(bd_prevalence, n(), 0.95),
              bd_prevalence_ci_upper = wilson_ci_upper(bd_prevalence, n(), 0.95),
              min_log_load_inf = min(log_bd_load[bd_load > 0]),
              q_25_log_load_inf = quantile(log_bd_load[bd_load > 0], probs = 0.25),
              q_50_log_load_inf = quantile(log_bd_load[bd_load > 0], probs = 0.50),
              q_75_log_load_inf = quantile(log_bd_load[bd_load > 0], probs = 0.75),
              max_log_load_inf = max(log_bd_load[bd_load > 0]),
              se = sqrt(bd_prevalence*(1-bd_prevalence)/n),
              .groups = "drop")
}

obs_stats_adult = sample_stats(bd_model) %>%
  mutate(species = get_species_name(taxon_capture))

ccdf_zeros = obs_stats_adult %>%
  group_by(taxon_capture) %>%
  mutate(log_bd_load = max_log_load_inf + 0.01,
         ccdf = 0,
         species = get_species_name(taxon_capture))

ccdf_adult = bd_model %>%
  mutate(species = get_species_name(taxon_capture),
         density = 1) %>%
  arrange(taxon_capture, desc(log_bd_load)) %>%
  group_by(taxon_capture) %>%
  mutate(n = n(),
         p = cumsum(density)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(taxon_capture, bd_detected)

ccdf_extended_adult = ccdf_adult %>%
  filter(!(bd_detected == FALSE) | row_number() == 1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(p = if_else(log_bd_load == -Inf, p - 1, p),
         log_bd_load = if_else(log_bd_load == -Inf, log(0.3), log_bd_load),
         ccdf = p / n) %>%
  bind_rows(ccdf_zeros) %>%
  arrange(taxon_capture, desc(log_bd_load)) %>%
  group_by(taxon_capture) %>%
  mutate(
    ksmooth_result = list(ksmooth(x = log_bd_load,
                                  y = ccdf,
                                  x.points = log_bd_load,
                                  kernel = "normal",
                                  bandwidth = 1)),
    ccdf_x = ksmooth_result[[1]]$x,
    ccdf_y = ksmooth_result[[1]]$y
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-ksmooth_result)

```

# Modeling

## Single model
```{r}

set_cmdstan_path(Sys.getenv("cmd_stan_path"))

mbd_full = brm(
  formula = bf(
    bd_load ~ taxon_capture + (1 | population) + season,
    hu ~ taxon_capture + (1 | population) + season,
    sigma ~ taxon_capture
  ),
  data = bd_model,
  family = hurdle_lognormal(),
  chains = 4,
  iter = 2000,
  warmup = 1000,
  cores = 4,
  seed = 125,
  backend = "cmdstanr"
)

saveRDS(mbd_full, file = here("penn_bd_summary_model/penn_summary_models/penn_combined_model.rds"))
mbd_full = readRDS(file = here("penn_bd_summary_model/penn_summary_models/penn_combined_model.rds"))
summary(mbd_full)

```

# marginal effects

```{r}

# marginal means for taxon_capture, averaged over season, on response scale
em_hu    = emmeans(mbd_full, ~ taxon_capture, dpar = "hu",    re_formula = NA, type = "response")
em_mu    = emmeans(mbd_full, ~ taxon_capture, dpar = "mu",    re_formula = NA)  # identity link already
em_sigma = emmeans(mbd_full, ~ taxon_capture, dpar = "sigma", re_formula = NA, type = "response")

# season effects, averaged over taxon_capture (sigma has no season term, will just replicate)
em_hu_season = emmeans(mbd_full, ~ season, dpar = "hu", re_formula = NA, type = "response")
em_mu_season = emmeans(mbd_full, ~ season, dpar = "mu", re_formula = NA)

summary(em_hu)
summary(em_mu)
summary(em_sigma)
summary(em_hu_season)
summary(em_mu_season)


```
# outputs

## species
```{r}

# ---- 1. Reference grids ----

# taxon_capture grid, averaged over season (population dropped via re_formula = NA)
grid_taxon <- bd_model %>%
  distinct(taxon_capture) %>%
  mutate(season = NA)  # placeholder; we'll cross below

# safer: cross taxon_capture with all season levels, then average draws over season
grid_taxon_season <- bd_model %>%
  distinct(taxon_capture, season)

# season grid, averaged over taxon_capture
grid_season_taxon <- bd_model %>%
  distinct(taxon_capture, season)

# ---- 2. Get draws for hu, mu, sigma at taxon_capture level (averaged over season) ----

draws_taxon <- grid_taxon_season %>%
  add_epred_draws(mbd_full, dpar = c("hu", "mu", "sigma"), re_formula = NA) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(taxon_capture, .draw) %>%
  summarize(hu = mean(hu), mu = mean(mu), sigma = mean(sigma), .groups = "drop")

# hu: keep all taxa
draws_hu <- draws_taxon %>%
  mutate(prev = 1 - hu)

# mu/sigma: drop the taxon whose hu is ~1 (no lognormal signal, prior-driven)
draws_mu_sigma <- draws_taxon %>%
  filter(taxon_capture != "plethodon_cinereus")

# ---- 3. Summarize each dpar ----

hu_summary    <- summarize_draws(draws_hu,        "prev",    taxon_capture)
mu_summary    <- summarize_draws(draws_mu_sigma,  "mu",    taxon_capture)
sigma_summary <- summarize_draws(draws_mu_sigma,  "sigma", taxon_capture)

# ---- 4. Order factor levels by median (descending), then plot ----

make_pointrange_plot <- function(summary_df, ylab, title) {
  summary_df <- summary_df %>%
    mutate(species = gsub("_", "\n", str_to_sentence(taxon_capture)))

  ggplot(summary_df, aes(x = species, y = mean, ymin = ci05, ymax = ci95)) +
    geom_pointrange() +
    labs(y = ylab, x = "Species", title = title) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1))
}

plot_prev    <- make_pointrange_plot(hu_summary,    "Prevalence Pr(Bd positive)\n(posterior mean ± 95% CrI)",       "Mean Bd prevalence (1 - hu)")
plot_mu    <- make_pointrange_plot(mu_summary,    "log(Bd load)\n(posterior mean ± 95% CrI)",         "Mean Bd-positive log-load (mu)")
plot_sigma <- make_pointrange_plot(sigma_summary, "log-scale Bd SD\n(posterior mean ± 95% CrI)",         "Residual Bd-positive SD (sigma)")


plot_hu
plot_mu
plot_sigma

ggsave(ggsave(filename = here("penn_bd_summary_model", "penn_bd_files", "penn_bd_adult_prev_draws_summary.png"),
       plot = plot_prev,

ggsave(ggsave(filename = here("penn_bd_summary_model", "penn_bd_files", "penn_bd_adult_load_draws_summary.png"),
       plot = plot_mu,

       width = 8))

ggsave(ggsave(filename = here("penn_bd_summary_model", "penn_bd_files", "penn_bd_adult_sigma_draws_summary.png"),
       plot = plot_sigma,

draws_summary_combined = hu_summary %>%
  rename_with(~ paste0("prev_", .), -taxon_capture) %>%
  left_join(mu_summary %>%
              rename_with(~ paste0("mu_", .), -taxon_capture), by = "taxon_capture") %>%
  left_join(sigma_summary %>%
              rename_with(~ paste0("sigma_", .), -taxon_capture), by = "taxon_capture") %>%
  rename(species = taxon_capture)
  

write_csv(draws_summary_combined, here("penn_bd_summary_model", "penn_bd_files", "penn_bd_adult_species_summary.csv"))
```

## season
```{r}
# note: sigma has no season term in your formula, so leave it out here

draws_season <- grid_season_taxon %>%
  add_epred_draws(mbd_full, dpar = c("hu", "mu"), re_formula = NA) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(prev = 1 - hu) %>%
  group_by(season, .draw) %>%
  summarize(prev = mean(prev), mu = mean(mu), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(prev, mu), names_to = "dpar", values_to = "value")

season_summary <- draws_season %>%
  group_by(season, dpar) %>%
  summarize(
    mean = mean(value),
    ci05 = quantile(value, 0.025),
    ci95 = quantile(value, 0.975),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(dpar = factor(dpar, levels = c("prev", "mu"),
                        labels = c("Mean Bd prevalence (1 - hu)", "Mean Bd-positive log-load (mu)")))

plot_season <- ggplot(season_summary, aes(x = season, y = mean, ymin = ci05, ymax = ci95)) +
  geom_pointrange() +
  facet_wrap(~ dpar, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(y = "Posterior mean ± 95% CrI", x = "Season", title = "Season effects") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1))

plot_season

ggsave(ggsave(filename = here("penn_bd_summary_model", "penn_bd_files", "penn_bd_adult_season_draws_summary.png"),
       plot = plot_season,
       height = 6,
       width = 8))

season_summary_wide = season_summary %>%
  mutate(dpar = recode_values(dpar,
    "Mean Bd-positive log-load (mu)" ~ "mu",
    "Mean Bd prevalence (1 - hu)" ~ "prev"
  )) %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = "season",
              names_from = "dpar",
              values_from = c("mean", "ci05", "ci95")) %>%
  select("season",
         "mean_prev",
         "ci05_prev",
         "ci95_prev",
         "mean_mu",
         "ci05_mu",
         "ci95_mu")

write_csv(season_summary_wide, here("penn_bd_summary_model", "penn_bd_files", "penn_bd_adult_seasons_summary.csv"))

```

# ccdf
```{r}
## modeled ccdf (season-averaged version)

# pull taxa
species_levels <- sort(unique(bd_model$taxon_capture))
season_levels  <- unique(bd_model$season)

# grid crosses taxon x season so we can average over season per draw
newdata_grid <- expand.grid(
  taxon_capture = species_levels,
  season = season_levels,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# extract linpred draws on response scale (n_draws x n_grid_rows)
mu_draws_full    <- posterior_linpred(mbd_full, newdata = newdata_grid,
                                       dpar = "mu",    transform = TRUE, re_formula = NA)
hu_draws_full    <- posterior_linpred(mbd_full, newdata = newdata_grid,
                                       dpar = "hu",    transform = TRUE, re_formula = NA)
sigma_draws_full <- posterior_linpred(mbd_full, newdata = newdata_grid,
                                       dpar = "sigma", transform = TRUE, re_formula = NA)

n_draws <- nrow(mu_draws_full)

# average each taxon's columns (across season) per draw -> n_draws x n_taxa
average_over_season <- function(draw_mat, grid, taxa) {
  out <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = nrow(draw_mat), ncol = length(taxa))
  colnames(out) <- taxa
  for (sp in taxa) {
    cols <- which(grid$taxon_capture == sp)
    out[, sp] <- rowMeans(draw_mat[, cols, drop = FALSE])
  }
  out
}

mu_draws    <- average_over_season(mu_draws_full,    newdata_grid, species_levels)
hu_draws    <- average_over_season(hu_draws_full,    newdata_grid, species_levels)
sigma_draws <- average_over_season(sigma_draws_full, newdata_grid, species_levels)
# (sigma has no season term, so this just deduplicates identical columns)

# build resample grid (unchanged)
pos_loads <- bd_model$bd_load[bd_model$bd_load > 0]
log_grid_resolution <- 200
log_grid <- seq(
  from = 0,
  to   = log(max(pos_loads)) + 0.5,
  length.out = log_grid_resolution
)

# ccdf (unchanged from your original loop)
ccdf_list <- vector("list", length(species_levels))

for (sp in species_levels) {

  mu_d    <- mu_draws[, sp]
  sigma_d <- sigma_draws[, sp]
  hu_d    <- hu_draws[, sp]

  z_mat <- outer(log_grid, mu_d, FUN = function(x, mu) x - mu)
  z_mat <- t(z_mat) / sigma_d

  surv_lognormal <- 1 - pnorm(z_mat)
  surv_total <- (1 - hu_d) * surv_lognormal

  q <- apply(surv_total, 2, quantile, probs = c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75), na.rm = TRUE)

  ccdf_list[[sp]] <- data.frame(
    taxon_capture = sp,
    log_load = log_grid,
    q25 = q[1, ],
    median = q[2, ],
    q75 = q[3, ]
  )
}

ccdf_df <- bind_rows(ccdf_list) %>%
  mutate(species = str_to_sentence(gsub("_", " ", taxon_capture)))

# define labels
label_df = ccdf_df %>%
  filter(
    #species %in% highlight_taxa,
         log_load < 4.8) %>%
  group_by(species) %>%
  slice_max(log_load) %>%
  ungroup()

# Updated plot
p_g <- ggplot(ccdf_df, aes(x = log_load, y = median)) +
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(ymin = q25, ymax = q75, fill = species),
    alpha = 0.25
  ) +
  # geom_line(aes(color = species, linewidth = species %in% highlight_taxa)) +
  geom_line(aes(color = species)) +
  # scale_linewidth_manual(values = c("TRUE" = 1.1, "FALSE" = 0.5)) +
  labs(
    x = "log(Bd load)",
    y = "Median P(Bd load > x)\nwith 25-75% posterior envelope",
    title = "Posterior complementary CDF of Bd infection load by species"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = label_df,
    aes(x = log_load, y = median, label = species, color = species),
    size = 3.5,
    fontface = "italic",
    nudge_x = 8,
    nudge_y = 0.14,
    direction = "y",
    hjust = 0,
    segment.size = 0.3,
    segment.color = "grey25",
    segment.linetype = "dotted",
    box.padding = 0.1,
    point.padding = 0,
    show.legend = FALSE
  )
p_g

ggsave(filename = here("penn_bd_summary_model", "penn_bd_files", "penn_bd_ccdf.png"),
       plot = p_g,
       height = 6,
       width = 8)


```
